answer_1.quote: We propose a powerful and scalable method for creating high-quality, ultra-detailed image captions, which is critical for enhancing the capabilities of LVLMs.

answer_2.quote: Traditional image caption evaluation metrics like CIDER, BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR rely on n-gram techniques... In contrast, CompreCap is a structured benchmark that evaluates detailed image descriptions using a scene graph... we report object coverage, pixel coverage, object score, and relation score.
automatic_metrics: CompreCap (object coverage, pixel coverage, object score, relation score)

answer_3.quote: We rely on existing open-source critic models (e.g., ) to provide preliminary scores for the image captions... we select low-scoring samples for human error correction. We also use GPT-4o to generate coarse‑grained error rationales and train a sentence‑level critic model that evaluates each atomic sentence.
methods: preliminary scoring of captions with critic models
LLM‑generated error rationales and atomic‑sentence critique

answer_4.quote: First, we use GPT-4o to generate captions for all images in the evaluation set, which are then manually revised and supplemented to form reference captions. After the test model generates its captions, human quality inspectors compare each test caption with the reference caption and image, evaluating them across three main dimensions: completeness, hallucination, and text quality.
answer_4.guideline: Inspectors assess whether each test caption meets or exceeds the reference caption in completeness, hallucination avoidance, and textual quality.
